ranks.name: Devata Rank
ranks.shortDesc: A great starting rank with extra homes and a colored name.
ranks.infoText:
The Devata Rank gives you:
- /home x3
- Colored name tag in chat
- Access to /kit devata (once every 24h)
- 2 extra sethomes

ranks.name: Apsara Rank
ranks.shortDesc: For the dedicated builder. More homes, more perks.
ranks.infoText:
The Apsara Rank includes everything in Devata, plus:
- /home x6
- /kit apsara (once every 12h)
- Particle trail cosmetics
- Priority queue on join

coins.name: 500 Angkor Coins
coins.shortDesc: Spend at the in-game /shop for cosmetics and crates.
coins.infoText: 500 Angkor Coins are added to your in-game balance within a few minutes of payment. Use /coins to check your balance in-game.

coins.name: 1200 Angkor Coins
coins.infoText: 1200 Angkor Coins (includes bonus coins) are added to your in-game balance within a few minutes of payment.

other.name: Vote Crate Key x5
other.shortDesc: 5 keys for the Vote Crate at spawn.
other.infoText: Delivered straight to your in-game inventory/mailbox. Use /crates to open them at any crate location.
